{{Quote|Ancestral legend has it that this nebula was once an arm of ''your'' galaxy&hellip; until cosmic upheaval ''sundered'' it. Now it drifts further and further into the void... Only this star and this planet surviving against all odds.|[[Klysk]], to Han Solo|<ref name="sw50" />}}
The '''Red Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained a single inhabited [[Planet of the Red Nebula|planet]], a multitude of stars, and a deadly [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]] field. The nebula boasted a race of [[Unidentified Red Nebula species|unidentified humanoids]] with pointed ears, who protected their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] bombardment with mystical red jewels.

A group of [[Red Nebula exiles|exiles]] led by [[Klysk]] attempted to steal and destroy the jewels but were thwarted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The jewels were eventually stolen and the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]] were destroyed by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], which intended to use them as a weapon against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], however, thwarted Tagge's plan and averted disaster.

==Description==
{{Quote|This place is ''alive'' with comets and meteors&hellip;!|Han Solo|<ref name="sw50" />}}
[[File:Red_Nebula_Comet_Field.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Red Nebula comet field]]
The Red Nebula appeared externally as a great [[Red|scarlet]] void against the pitch-black backdrop of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], but internally there was no hint of the scarlet hue. A [[Awesome cataclysm|cosmic cataclysm]] effectively isolating the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] physically and culturally, gradually pushing into the further reaches of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="sw50" />

A highly unstable locale, the Red Nebula was home to perilous [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]] fields and [[Comet/Legends|comets]], making transit dangerous and often fatal. There was at least one inhabited [[Planet of the Red Nebula|planet]] within, home to a small sect of [[Priests of the Red Nebula|priests]] and a variety of creatures. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was battered and pockmarked by the meteors of the nebula, save for a lush and [[Color/Legends|green]] small valley, preserved by the power of two [[Great Life Jewels]]. Passage to the planet required navigating the meteor fields, restricting access to only the most skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], or those with exceptionally detailed navigation charts.<ref name="sw50" />

The nebula had an [[Onion/Legends|onion]] named after it, the [[Red Nebula onion]], which was served in [[nerfsteak sandwich]]es at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="dd">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

==History==
===Early history and separation===
Originally, the Red Nebula was contained in the outermost reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Only one [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was known to support life within the nebula, which resided close to one of the many stars within. A [[Unidentified Red Nebula species|sentient species]] that resembled the [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] inhabited the planet,<ref name="Leland">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM|quote=For the longest time we've used dozens of pointy-eared characters without a species name for them. The pointed-eared species in the Jedi: Yoda comic were named Sephi. My theory is that all pointy-eared species are either Sephi or closely related to Sephi.}} The inhabitants of the Red Nebula fit this description and so may be related to the Sephi.</ref> alongside a series of creatures that dwelled within the planet's [[Wood/Legends|forest]]. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] practiced a faith which held belief in the "[[Cosmic Destiny]]." All known inhabitants of the planet were priests at some stage.<ref name="sw50" />

At one [[Time/Legends|time]], some form of [[Awesome cataclysm|cosmic cataclysm]] pushed the Red Nebula into the further reaches of the galaxy, isolating it from all other civilizations. During the separation, two great gems, which the priests named the "Great Life Jewels," were brought to the planet. It was quickly learned that when the two jewels were separated, they would instill a plague (known as the [[Crimson Forever]]) within those who made contact.<ref name="sw50" />

The separation also generated substantial meteor fields and [[Meteor shower/Legends|showers]], which eventually impacted upon the planet. Most of the world was destroyed by meteors turning it into a pockmarked, [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]], barren wasteland. Only the area surrounding the [[Red Nebula temple|temple that housed the Great Life Jewels]] was untouched, remaining the fertile and bountiful land it had originally been.<ref name="sw50" />

===Schism===
[[File:Klysk.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Klysk, denouncer of the Great Life Jewels]]
[[Standard year/Legends|Centuries]] later, the separation of the nebula also divided its inhabitants. Some of the priests believed that they were supposed to have perished in the cataclysm, and thought that the Great Life Jewels were "blasphemous abominations" that should have been destroyed in order to let nature take its course. The majority of the priests, however, considered that viewpoint ludicrous and had the [[Red Nebula exiles|detractors]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]].<ref name="sw50" />

At some stage after that, the nebula played host to an intergalactic chase, as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] pursued and captured the pirate [[Alabar Double Ax]] there.<ref name="thw">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}</ref>

Those exiled from the nebula did not take their banishment lying down. They found their way into the known galaxy and patrolled [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], amassing a small army of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who were pressed into service. They intended to use that [[Army/Legends|army]] to reclaim the jewels and destroy them, along with themselves and all of their kind. The final additions to the band, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], were abducted on [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]] and imprisoned on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the exiles, the ''[[Nova Prince]]''.<ref name="sw50" />

===The theft of the Great Life Jewels===
{{Quote|I tried to ''warn'' you Han Solo&hellip;now you've ''doomed'' us all!|Red Nebula priest|<ref name="sw50" />}}
{{Main|Attack on the Red Nebula temple}}
[[Klysk]], the leader of the exiles, set off on a voyage to his home aboard the ''Prince'' with the captive army. Upon reaching the meteor fields of the nebula, though, Solo convinced the ex-priest to let him pilot the ship instead of what the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] thought to be a fallible and dangerous [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. Despite skirting close to [[Death/Legends|death]] several times, Solo piloted the bulky [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] through the field and onto the Red Nebula's planet intact.<ref name="sw50" />

[[File:Battle_of_red_nebula.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Klysk leads the charge on the Red Nebula temple.]]
The mercenaries were told that they could plunder anything they found, save for the two Great Life Jewels in the Red Nebula temple. They were to be retrieved and returned to Klysk together. Attacking the [[Untouched Valley]] with the other criminals, Solo and Chewbacca [[Attack on the Red Nebula temple|fought]] their way through the priests' defensive [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] perimeter, and made it to the temple, where they were met by a single [[Unidentified priest (Red Nebula)|priest]]. The priest made no attempt to personally bar Solo from retrieving the jewels, and instead released the [[Red Nebula temple guardian|temple guardian]]. The guardian, a large beast, was instead distracted by Chewbacca, whom she thought to be a pup of hers, and began to perform maternal activities. That allowed Solo to steal the jewels, and escape back to the ''Nova Prince''.<ref name="sw50" />

Solo, thinking that he had the upper hand with his possession of the jewels, sought to make demands of Klysk, who had other ideas. He betrayed Solo and left him stranded on the planet, thinking that he had possession of the Great Life Jewels. Solo, however, had switched the genuine jewels for duplicates. For safekeeping, he had hidden the originals in the valley. Klysk did not notice the switch and continued his mission to destroy the jewels and all life in the Red Nebula. Solo returned to the temple, where Chewbacca and the priest were waiting with the guardian. The priest, panicking, led Solo into an underground shelter, where they watched on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] as Klysk piloted the ''Nova Prince'' into the [[Sun of the Planet of the Red Nebula|sun]]. The priest did not understand why the valley was not instantly destroyed until Solo revealed that he had hidden the crystals safely. Grateful, the priest presented Solo and Chewbacca with a ship that would take them safely back to the galaxy.<ref name="sw50" />

===Armageddon, courtesy of TaggeCo===
{{Main|Mission to the Red Nebula}}
[[File:TaggeCo_customer_service.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Domina Tagge's Mining Explorer decimates the last remaining city of the Red Nebula.]]
Several years later, [[Spy/Legends|spies]] enlisted by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] gathered intelligence on the Great Life Jewels and learned they would produce the Crimson Forever plague when separated. Seeing an opportunity to avenge her [[Orman Tagge/Legends|brother's]] death at the hands of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Tagge planned to somehow deliver one of the crystals to the young Rebel, thereby killing him with the potential deadly disease. Hiring the services of the bounty hunters [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[IG-88C/Legends|IG-88C]], [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]], and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], Tagge took a [[Mining Explorer]] to the Red Nebula in [[Mission to the Red Nebula|search]] of the legendary crystals. Leaving nothing to chance, the Mining Explorer gratuitously bombarded the Untouched Valley, destroying the temple. She then sent the bounty hunters down to retrieve the jewels. They did so, although they also encountered the lone priest whom Solo had dealt with years before. As they captured him and took the jewels, an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that had been dispatched by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to keep tabs on Tagge entered the nebula and forced the Mining Explorer to accept boarders.<ref name="sw50" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] retrieved one of the jewels with a minimum of fuss, but the bounty hunters instigated a [[Lightfight|firefight]]. The Imperials were forced to retreat with just one jewel, encased in a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] box that had been tampered with by Tagge to burst under the pressure of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. However, the Red Nebula priest unleashed the second jewel from its own carbonite box, causing the Crimson Forever to take effect due to the separation. That act rendered most of the Mining Explorer contaminated and left Tagge trapped with the bounty hunters.<ref name="sw50" />

Acting on intelligence that Tagge had given them before the firefight, the Imperials journeyed to the Rebel base on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]]. They had all succumbed to the Crimson Forever caused by the lone jewel, and upon investigating the silent ship, Luke Skywalker was infected, per Tagge's original goal. Seeking to find a cure, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] sped to the Red Nebula with due haste, only to find the Mining Explorer a floating derelict. They [[Skirmish aboard the Mining Explorer|convinced]] the trapped Tagge to help them in their plight, and saved Skywalker.<ref name="sw50" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Red_Nebula_dude.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Red Nebula priest with Captain Han Solo]]
The Red Nebula, specifically the planet of the Red Nebula, was home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with red skin and pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. The humanoids were devoted to their belief in the Cosmic Destiny and had erected at least one temple. A small city was all that was left of their civilization after the cataclysm had caused their planet to be bombarded with meteors, and the examples of their race were all, at some stage, priests. They did have a grasp of advanced technology, a holdover from the time when the Nebula was connected to the galaxy, and they had ships capable of leaving the Red Nebula. They also had a system of tunnels built under their city, complete with viewscreens, and a perimeter of laser cannons to ward off intruders.<ref name="sw50" />

The planet was also home to a large [[Grudakk|Grundakk]]-like creature that guarded the temple. The creature survived Domina Tagge's bombardment in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="sw50" />

==Locations==
===Planet of the Red Nebula===
[[File:Red_Nebula_planet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Planet of the Red Nebula]]
{{Main|Planet of the Red Nebula}}
Circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], there was only one planet<ref name="sw50" /> remaining in the Red Nebula, which was home to the inhabitants of the Red Nebula. It was also the home to the religion of the Cosmic Destiny, and the Red Nebula temple guardian. After the cataclysm, the planet was bombarded with meteors from the newly formed field, effectively wiping out all civilization save for one small valley, where a group of priests continued to exist. The valley was ringed with powerful defensive laser cannons, and its underground was riddled with tunnels and bunkers. The valley was razed to the ground by Domina Tagge in 3 ABY.<ref name="sw50" />

===Red Nebula comet field===
{{Main|Red Nebula comet field}}
The Red Nebula comet, or meteor, field ringed the nebula, effectively providing a natural barrier to deter would-be intruders. Composed of fragments from long-dead [[Star/Legends|stars]] and planets, it was an especially perilous field, and could only be navigated by the most skilled pilots, or blasted through with large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="sw50" />

===Sun of the planet of the Red Nebula===
{{Main|Sun of the Planet of the Red Nebula}}
The sun of the planet of the Red Nebula was larger than other stars in the nebula, and was the only one known to have an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] planet. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], ex-priest Klysk piloted ''Nova Prince'' into it in the name of his religion.<ref name="sw50" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Red Nebula was created by [[Archie Goodwin]], and first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] issue [[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]], where it served as the central location. It has since been referenced elsewhere in ''[[Star Wars]]'' media in [[Jason Fry]]'s ''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]'' scenario for [[Wizards of the Coast]], in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', and in "[[Dining at Dex's]]." It is possible, though not confirmed, that the humanoid species were related to the Sephi of [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]].<ref name="Leland" />
